desc: Ideation complete: selected grouped generating function with low-order differential recurrence as primary approach.
Implement grouped generating function with low-order differential recurrence for coefficients of P(z)=prod_d(1+w_d z)^{c_d}.
Compute digit-length counts and modulo sums of numbers in each digit-length group.
Precompute factorials and modular inverses, divide by (1+w_d z), compute multipliers, and combine final answer.
Test sample inputs and edge cases such as N=1, powers of 10, and large N.
